verdict.rationale:
Docs show a run dashboard with searchable/filterable columns (including custom JSON-path smart columns), a documented run lifecycle with multiple states, and explicit retry/backoff behavior surfaced per task, plus a management API to list/query runs by status. Community feedback corroborates the dashboard UI as polished and useful for iterating on jobs.

missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-step timeline UI showing inputs/outputs for each individual step (not just run-level states), and independent hands-on confirmation of searching/filtering that per-step detail.
